Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and positioned at anterior carapace corners.
Carapace is squarish to trapezoidal with smooth surface.
Carapace displays grey, brown, or greenish coloration with darker mottling.
Body_and_Plumage: Carapace is notably small and compact.
Male exhibits one massively enlarged claw comprising up to half of total body weight.
Enlarged claw is smooth, rounded, and brightly colored in red, orange, yellow, or white.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Female has two small equal claws.
Four pairs of walking legs are slender with flattened terminal segments.
Legs adapted for rapid sideways locomotion.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and small relative to massive body size.
Carapace is rounded to heart-shaped with prominent spines and tubercles.
Carapace displays reddish-brown to purple-brown coloration with lighter mottling.
Body_and_Plumage: Broad spiny carapace of very large proportions.
Leg span is exceptionally wide, vastly exceeding body width.
Exoskeleton is thick, heavily calcified, and rough-textured due to spination.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Five pairs of extremely long, robust walking legs covered with sharp spines.
First pair modified into moderately sized claws, smaller relative to body than true crabs.
Abdomen is reduced and folded ventrally.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and compound.
Antennae are long and whip-like.
Cephalothorax protected by smooth carapace with prominent rostral spines.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated cylindrical body of large marine decapod proportions.
Hard calcified exoskeleton displaying dark bluish-green to brownish-green coloration.
Segmented body with hard calcified exoskeleton.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Large asymmetrical claws: one massive crusher claw with blunt teeth, one smaller cutter claw with sharp edges.
Five pairs of walking legs extend from thorax, first three bearing small claws.
Tail fan (telson and uropods) is broad and paddle-shaped.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and prominent.
Antennae are extremely long, thick, and spiny, exceeding body length.
Small first antennae (antennules) are short and brush-like.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated cylindrical body of large marine decapod proportions, lacking enlarged claws.
Hard spiny exoskeleton displaying reddish-brown, purple, or greenish-brown coloration.
Carapace heavily armored with prominent forward-pointing spines and tubercles.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Five pairs of walking legs are robust with terminal claws.
Abdomen (tail) is muscular and segmented with broad tail fan.
Texture is rough and heavily spined throughout.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and compound.
Two pairs of antennae: first pair short, second pair long and slender.
Cephalothorax protected by smooth carapace with cervical groove visible laterally.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated segmented body of small freshwater proportions, resembling a miniature lobster.
Hard exoskeleton displaying reddish-brown, greenish-brown, or dark brown coloration.
Exoskeleton texture is smooth to slightly granulated.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: First pair of appendages modified into prominent claws, typically equal in size.
Remaining four pairs are walking legs with small terminal claws.
Tail fan is broad and fan-shaped.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are stalked and prominent.
Antennae are long and segmented.
Anterior body (cephalothorax) is hardened displaying reddish, brown, or orange coloration.
Body_and_Plumage: Body of small to moderate size, inhabiting abandoned gastropod shells.
Asymmetrical soft abdomen coiled to fit spiral shell interior.
When removed from shell, abdomen reveals soft, pale, uncalcified texture.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: First pair of appendages are unequal claws: one larger for blocking shell aperture, one smaller for feeding.
Remaining legs adapted for gripping shell interior and locomotion.
Hooked appendages (pleopods) on abdomen for shell attachment.

Head_and_Face: Antennae are prominent with multiple segments.
Eyes are compound and sessile (not stalked).
Head (cephalon) is distinct from thorax segments.
Body_and_Plumage: Dorsoventrally flattened elongated body, varying from minute to remarkably large across species.
Body segmented into head, thorax with seven pairs of similar walking legs, and abdomen.
Coloration ranges from grey, brown, white, to translucent.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Seven pairs of similar walking legs (isopod = equal feet).
Abdomen ends in uropods.
Terrestrial species can roll into defensive ball (volvation).

Head_and_Face: Head and neck are white with fine black feathering around eyes.
Bill is long, straight, pointed, and bright red, notably elongated relative to head size.
Eyes are dark with fine black feathering around them.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly brilliant white, of large wading-bird proportions.
Contrasting glossy black primary and secondary flight feathers visible in flight.
Tail feathers are black with white undertail coverts.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs and feet are long and bright red adapted for wading.
Wings are broad and flat with black coverts creating sharp demarcation from white body.
Flight posture features straight neck extension.

Head_and_Face: Head and neck are black with fine elongated feathers creating shaggy appearance.
Bill is long, straight, pointed, and bright red, notably elongated relative to head size.
Eyes are dark with shaggy black feathering around them.
Body_and_Plumage: Glossy black upperparts displaying iridescent green and purple sheen in direct light.
Pure white underparts from breast to undertail coverts.
Body is of large wading-bird proportions with broad wingspan.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs and feet are long and bright red adapted for wading.
Wings are broad with black flight feathers matching body coloration.
Flight posture features straight neck extension.

Head_and_Face: Elongated flat bill with spatulate tip resembling a spoon, notably long relative to head.
Bill color ranges from black to grey with yellow tip depending on species.
Crest of elongated feathers extends from nape during breeding season.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly white with some species displaying pink, yellow, or black accents.
Body is of medium to large wading-bird proportions with broad wingspan.
Wings are broad with colored primary feathers visible in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long and dark grey to black adapted for wading.
Neck is long and S-curved.
Flight posture features neck retraction in S-curve.
